name: 医师资格考试
description: 国家医师资格考试报名、实践技能、医学综合考试和二试节点。
description_en: Key dates for China medical licensing exam, including practical skills and written examinations.

events.name: 2026年医师资格考试报名
events.description: 医师资格考试网上报名窗口，各地资格审核和缴费安排以考区通知为准。
events.description_en: Online registration window for the medical licensing exam; qualification review and payment arrangements follow test-region notices.

events.name: 2026年医师资格实践技能考试
events.name_en: 2026 National Medical Licensing Examination Practical Skills Exam
events.description: 实践技能考试由各省级医师资格考试领导小组组织实施，具体类别和时间以准考证为准。
events.description_en: The practical skills exam is organized by provincial medical licensing exam leading groups; categories and times follow the admission ticket.

events.name: 2026年医师资格医学综合考试
events.name_en: 2026 National Medical Licensing Examination General Medical Knowledge Exam
events.description: 医学综合考试第一试，具体类别和场次以国家医学考试网公告和准考证为准。
events.description_en: First sitting of the general medical knowledge exam; categories and sessions follow National Medical Examination Center announcements and the admission ticket.

events.name: 2026年医师资格医学综合二试
events.name_en: 2026 National Medical Licensing Examination General Medical Knowledge Second Sitting
events.description: 医学综合考试第二试，是否开考和报考范围以当年公告为准。
events.description_en: Second sitting of the general medical knowledge exam; whether it is held and who may sit it follow the year's announcement.
